subject: A tiny web experiment: one page, one owner, until the next takeover
text:
Hi Jason,

Your About page invites projects and videos, so here's a small web experiment at the intersection of design and internet nonsense.

I built Take The Wall around a single constraint: one shared homepage, one owner at a time. Someone puts their message or project there; the next takeover replaces it. The interesting question is what people choose to put in that one spot.

Live site: https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=kottke&utm_medium=editorial_pitch&utm_campaign=wall_demo

The attached 15-second animation demonstrates the replacement with clearly labeled examples. Video link: https://x.com/serhansarii/status/2098881087174803759

Anyone can watch without paying. Publishing a takeover is paid, and the site also has milestone rewards subject to its published rules.

If the premise fits something you'd share, I'd appreciate you taking a look. I'm sending it for editorial consideration, not requesting a sponsored placement.

Thanks,
Take The Wall
